name: Soul Rope (Retro Formats)
desc: Activate only by paying 1000 Life Points when a monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from your Deck.

cdb_provenance.detail: type, atk, def, level, race, attribute and setcode are copied from the row for the modern card (37383714) in cards.cdb at the ignis-babelcdb revision pinned in data/sources.json. They are NOT independently checked against a period printing: a stat change between the period card and the modern one would not be reproduced. category (a client search filter, not gameplay) is left 0 rather than copied. ot is 8 (SCOPE_ILLEGAL) as for every historical-implementation row upstream.

modified.summary: no "by a card effect" requirement (REASON_EFFECT), and activation allowed in the Damage Step (EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP), as the period text has neither restriction.

authorship.note: Adapted from Project Ignis's script for the modern card, official/c37383714.lua at the ignis-cardscripts pin, by applying only the period difference the erratum record states (the summary above) and pointing the effect description at the modern card's strings, because this generated row carries none. It is licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later like its upstream (LICENSES/AGPL-3.0-or-later.txt); the rest of this repository stays MIT. Round 031 labelled it original, written without opening any Project Ignis card script; round 031's review measured that version as too close to this upstream file to be independent, and the owner decided on 2026-09-27 that such scripts are credited, labelled derived and kept under the upstream's licence. Round 032 rebased it on the upstream file itself.

not_reproduced: Damage Step activation is the engine's own window for a card carrying EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP: the record's sources establish that the period text carries no Damage Step exclusion, not where in the Damage Step a period player could have activated it. The record itself notes that its sources establish that the 2012 printing added "(except during the Damage Step)", not that period policy independently allowed Damage Step activation of a trap with a general destruction trigger. Only the fact that it is offered after a monster is destroyed by battle is tested.
"Activate only by paying 1000 Life Points" is implemented as a cost paid on activation.

"Is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard" is implemented as the engine's to-Graveyard event for a monster the activating player controlled on the field that was destroyed; it applies to any destruction cause.

The Level 4 monster is chosen from the Deck at resolution and Special Summoned face-up Attack Position into any free Monster Zone; whether it may be Special Summoned at all is the engine's ordinary check (Level 4 in the Deck), and monsters with their own Special Summon conditions are not modelled.
The Trap row has no statline; its type and text come from the modern row and the record.
